title: Tone of Voice
slide_intent: Signal a change from identifying the book to reading about language. A short section title gives the reader one subject to carry into the following guidance.
strategic_value: Opening with voice can give the brand’s wording the same editorial importance as its visual assets.
demonstration: The white section name sits alone across the middle of a dark field with a small mark above and folio below.
practical_value: Use this page as the opening beat of a chapter and place the actual writing principles on the next page.

content_islands.name: Book identifiers
content_islands.spec: Place a small white Bolt mark in the upper-left corner and the folio in the lower-left corner.

content_islands.name: Section title
content_islands.spec: Set “Tone of Voice” in large white type on the dark full-page field. Align the title near mid-height, inset farther than the small identifiers.
